description: Injects the response-format spec at session start and a short reminder every turn (per-turn reinjection counters within-session drift). The gate script prints plain stdout, which becomes context, only when the session resolves on: a /p:fmt-on or /p:fmt-off session toggle wins, then the configured default (P_FORMAT_DEFAULT, per-harness, or global in polstools/format.json), then off. A missing payload shows a hook error without blocking the prompt.
